title: Future perfect: looking back from a future point
meaningZh: 到将来某时为止将已经完成
meaningEn: completion viewed from a future reference point
explanation: 将来完成时用will have加过去分词，从一个将来参照点回看某行动已完成。By Friday, we will have tested the backup equipment把周五作为期限。这种说法是在预测、安排或假设基础上作出的未来判断，不证明现在已经测试完，也不保证计划必然实现。
usage: 交代到某期限预计完成的事项，或说明未来时点之前累计的结果。
nuance: by常标出不晚于某时的期限；at仅定位时刻。过去分词不因主语改变，will后也不改成has。
structure: Subject + will have + past participle + by + future time
formation: Subject + will have + past participle + by + future time

examples.target: By Friday, we will have tested the backup equipment.
examples.zh: 到周五，我们预计将已经测试完备用设备。

examples.target: She will have checked the invoice by tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 到明早，她将已核查完发票。

examples.target: By the end of the rehearsal, we will have tried both microphones.
examples.zh: 到排练结束时，我们将已试过两支麦克风。

examples.target: They will have signed the contract by next week if the final details are agreed.
examples.zh: 如果最后的细节谈妥，到下周他们将已签署合同。

notes: 等级为教学编排，不代表官方穷尽语法清单。

commonMistakes.wrong: By Friday, we will have test the equipment.
commonMistakes.correct: By Friday, we will have tested the equipment.
commonMistakes.explanation: have后接过去分词tested，不能使用原形test。

comparison.explanation: have tested从现在回看已完成；will have tested从未来参照点回看，不能把未来安排当作现时完成证据。

exercises.prompt: “By Friday, we will have tested the backup equipment.” 可以直接确认什么？
acceptedAnswers: 说话人预计到周五时测试已经完成
exercises.explanation: 这是从未来期限回看的判断，不能据此证明当前已经完成。
options: 说话时所有测试已经完成
说话人预计到周五时测试已经完成
测试只能在周五之后开始

exercises.prompt: By Friday, we will have ( ) the equipment.
想说明到排练结束时两支麦克风都预计试过，哪句准确？
acceptedAnswers: By the end of the rehearsal, we will have tried both microphones.
exercises.explanation: 参照点是排练结束，动作在此之前预计完成；不是报告此刻正在做什么。
options: By the end of the rehearsal, we will have tried both microphones.
At this moment, we are trying one microphone.
We will begin trying the microphones after the rehearsal.

exercises.prompt: 改正分词：By Friday, we will have test the equipment.
acceptedAnswers: By Friday, we will have tested the equipment.
exercises.explanation: have后用tested组成完成结构，不改动原期限。

exercises.prompt: 译成英语：到明早，她将已核查完发票。
acceptedAnswers: She will have checked the invoice by tomorrow morning.
exercises.explanation: will have checked表达未来参照点前的完成，by tomorrow morning给出期限。
